Purchases, charges, and refunds

Apple handles these: for subscriptions, click Manage Subscription ↗ in the Purchase & Access window; ask Apple for refunds.

No need to send your focus records. We use your email only to reply; see the Privacy Policy.

Hoursight records the time you spend focusing. It is not a medical or therapeutic tool.
